creative_direction_json.core_angle: Customer support is a roadmap signal when the same pain appears repeatedly.
creative_direction_json.point_of_view: A solo founder looking back on a practical operating lesson.
creative_direction_json.narration_strategy: Plainspoken first-person reflection with no hype.
creative_direction_json.visual_strategy: Quiet desk scenes, anonymized ticket patterns, sketches, and a simple roadmap board with no readable UI text.
creative_direction_json.music_strategy: Soft pulse that grows slightly as the plan becomes clearer.
consistency_rules: Use the same founder workspace across scenes.
Do not show readable ticket text or product UI.

hook_option_1: I stopped guessing what to build when I reread the support inbox.
hook_option_2: The roadmap was hiding in the same customer complaint, repeated again and again.
hook_option_3: One founder habit changed our product direction: tagging every support ticket.
selected_hook: The roadmap was hiding in the same customer complaint, repeated again and again.
narration_script: The roadmap was hiding in the same customer complaint, repeated again and again. At first, every support ticket felt like a distraction from building. Then patterns started to show up. Three different customers were asking for the same fix in different words. Instead of adding another idea to a wish list, I grouped the pain, sketched the workflow, and turned the loudest pattern into the next release. The lesson was simple: support is not just where problems arrive. It is where priorities become visible.
short_script: Repeated customer pain can be a better roadmap than founder guesses.
caption_draft: A simple founder habit: tag repeated support pain before planning the next feature.
cta_line: Save this before your next roadmap review.
music_direction: Warm minimal piano with a subtle pulse, no dramatic hits.
